The reported internal review is retained at its actual mathematical scope; external acceptance is not a prerequisite added by intake. Actual LABELLEDcomplete resets, separately executable memoryless residual channels and physically shifted controls are required; a mathematical decomposition of an unlabelled noisy channel does not supply those ports. The one-quarter condition is sufficient, not critical, and equal edge weights are substantive. Local samples do not provide adaptive access to one shared global quantum sample, and conditioning on the current history changes the output. Short burn-in defeated exact sampling at the tested precision; no hardware or practical advantage.
